stem: A cultivar receives more phosphorus and potassium, while leaf magnesium concentration falls. What is the best first interpretation?
choices: A nutrient interaction may be influencing uptake or tissue concentration and should be investigated with the full root-zone and formulation context
Magnesium is never needed during vegetative growth
The plant must have a fungal disease
rationale: Cannabis nutrition studies demonstrate interactions among supplied nutrients; one changing tissue value should be interpreted with the formulation and root-zone context rather than assigned to a single cause.
